cohort: 200 pregnant women diagnosed with uterine fibroids via ultrasound at a tertiary hospital in India.
finding: Uterine fibroids in pregnancy are linked to increased risks of early pregnancy abortion, term pregnancy premature rupture of membranes (PROM), postpartum hemorrhage (PPH), malpresentation, and significantly higher rates of caesarean section.
mod_finding: Pregnant women with uterine fibroids exhibited a high rate of caesarean section (62%), with 25% having vaginal births and others having instrumental or aided breech deliveries.
